children: Pundi X will participate in SWITCH 2026 at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from October 27th through October 29th. The three-day conference will cover innovation, AI and fintech.
Pundi X is heading to SWITCH 2026 - Singapore Week of Innovation & Technology!
📍 Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
3 days of innovation, AI, fintech, and big ideas.
Pundi X (PUNDIX) is a revolutionary blockchain-powered solution with a mission to enable retail merchants and consumers to carry out instantaneous transactions in physical stores on its blockchain.

It's developed a comprehensive blockchain payment ecosystem comprising the XPOS, XPASS, and XWallet. The XWallet mobile app and virtual XPASS card offer a seamless connection between traditional digital asset wallets and the Pundi X payment ecosystem. The platform also hosts various ERC20 tokens from DeFi developers and projects, enhancing its usage.
The PUNDIX token, central to this ecosystem, is utilized for transactions, services fees, and various rewards within the platform.

title: Pundi X to Participate in SWITCH 2026 in Singapore on October 27th
